findings: The APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant was found in 9.8% of FH probands (n=63/234) with an OR=4.9 (p=6.9×10⁻¹³).
Functional analysis showed reduced LDL internalization efficiency in hepatocytes for p.(Pro955Ser) compared to controls (p<0.01).
Dose-dependent effect observed: homozygous p.(Pro955Ser) showed greater impairment than heterozygous (p<0.01).
rationale: The variant demonstrates both statistical association (high OR) and functional impairment in a disease-relevant assay (hepatocyte LDL uptake), meeting PS3 criteria.
experimental_details: LDL internalization measured by fluorescence intensity after 30-min incubation at 37°C. Compared wild-type, heterozygous p.(Pro955Ser), homozygous p.(Pro955Ser), and pathogenic p.(Arg3527Gln) controls. Biological replicates n=3 per group.
p2_source_location: Figure 3 legend: 'p<0.01 between control and each variant'
